verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a desktop agentic IDE, but the evidence pack documents no export feature for chat sessions, account data, or settings. Workspace files are local, skills are SKILL.md files, the IDE is described as open-source, and enterprise self-hosting exists, but these are adjacent properties, not a documented capability to export all user data in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
